hypothesis: In some types of non-Alzheimer's, non-aged human brain cells, for example astrocytes, APOE4 causes reduced endosome pH compared with APOE3.

paper.title: Neuronal endolysosomal alterations induced by Apolipoprotein E4 emerge over time in primary neurons.

findings.finding_description: Live-cell LysoTracker Red imaging of GFP-labelled neurons in 25–26 DIV mixed cortical/hippocampal cultures from human APOE knock-in mice. Total LysoTracker intensity per neuronal cell body was 35.6% lower in ApoE4 than ApoE3 neurons. This points to less acidified compartments with ApoE4, the opposite direction to the hypothesis. pH was inferred from a non-ratiometric dye, not measured.
findings.quote: we detected a 19.8% lower number of LysoTracker positive vesicles (p = 0.011) and a 35.6% lower total LysoTracker intensity per neuronal cell body (p = 0.0059) in ApoE4 compared to ApoE3 neurons (Fig. 4, I–K)
findings.summary: ApoE4 neurons aged in culture show 35.6% less LysoTracker signal than ApoE3, suggesting less acidic rather than more acidic degradative compartments (against the hypothesis).
findings.experimental_system: primary hippocampal/cortical neurons (mixed cultures with astrocytes) from human ApoE4 vs ApoE3 targeted-replacement mouse embryos, 25-26 DIV, live imaging

findings.finding_description: Same live-cell LysoTracker experiment, counting LysoTracker-positive spots per neuronal cell body. ApoE4 neurons had 19.8% fewer acidic vesicles than ApoE3 neurons. The authors read this as fewer active acidic degradative compartments, again not the more acidic phenotype the hypothesis predicts.
findings.quote: one-way ANOVA (K) p = 0.014, post hoc Tukey’s p = 0.011 (19.8% mean difference)
findings.summary: ApoE4 neurons have ~20% fewer LysoTracker-positive (acidic) vesicles than ApoE3 after prolonged culture.
findings.experimental_system: primary hippocampal/cortical neurons from human ApoE4 vs ApoE3 targeted-replacement mouse embryos, 25-26 DIV, live imaging

findings.finding_description: DQ BSA degradation (8 h) in 25-26 DIV neurons, a protease-dependent readout. Lysosomal proteolysis depends on acidification: bafilomycin abolished the signal in N2A cells. Integrated DQ BSA intensity in cell bodies was 21.9% lower in ApoE4 than ApoE3, consistent with less, not more, acidic or active lysosomes.
findings.quote: remarkably the degradation of DQ BSA after 8 h was reduced with ApoE4, consistent with a significant reduction in DQ BSA integrated intensity in the cell bodies compared to ApoE3 (Fig. 4, F and G, 21.9%, p = 0.0495)
findings.summary: Aged-in-culture ApoE4 neurons degrade DQ BSA ~22% less than ApoE3, an indirect sign of reduced lysosomal acidity/activity.
findings.experimental_system: primary hippocampal/cortical neurons from human ApoE4 vs ApoE3 targeted-replacement mouse embryos, 25-26 DIV

findings.finding_description: Number of DQ BSA-positive (proteolytically active) compartments in neuronal cell bodies at 25 DIV. Counts were 20% lower in ApoE4 than ApoE3 neurons.
findings.quote: We further noticed that the number of vesicles containing DQ BSA in the cell bodies was significantly lower both in ApoE4 (20%, p = 0.0195) and ApoE KO (17.8%, p = 0.0048) compared to ApoE3 neurons (Fig. 4H).
findings.summary: ApoE4 neurons have 20% fewer active degradative compartments than ApoE3 at 25 DIV.
findings.experimental_system: primary hippocampal/cortical neurons from human ApoE4 vs ApoE3 targeted-replacement mouse embryos, 25-26 DIV

findings.finding_description: DQ BSA degradation (8 h) in mature, younger 18 DIV neurons. There was no difference between ApoE KO, ApoE3 and ApoE4 in cell bodies or dendrites. This is a null result for the acidification-dependent degradation surrogate in non-aged cultures.
findings.quote: When we compared our ApoE groups at 18 DIV there were no differences in the total intensities of DQ BSA in dendrites or cell bodies between ApoE KO, ApoE3, and ApoE4 neurons after 8 h (Fig. 2, G and H).
findings.summary: No ApoE4 vs ApoE3 difference in lysosomal degradation in 18 DIV (non-aged) neurons.
findings.experimental_system: primary hippocampal/cortical neurons from human ApoE4 vs ApoE3 targeted-replacement mouse embryos, 18 DIV

findings.finding_description: Autofluorescent lipofuscin granule area in astrocytes within the 25 DIV mixed cultures. Area was significantly higher in ApoE4 than ApoE3 astrocytes, indicating a lysosomal degradation defect in ApoE4 astrocytes. Lipofuscin is only a distal surrogate for endolysosomal pH.
findings.quote: significantly higher levels of lipofuscin accumulation in ApoE4 compared to ApoE KO and ApoE3 astrocytes (Fig. 5M)
findings.summary: ApoE4 astrocytes accumulate 49% more lipofuscin than ApoE3 astrocytes in aged cultures, a weak indirect lysosomal-function signal.
findings.experimental_system: astrocytes in primary hippocampal/cortical mixed cultures from human ApoE4 vs ApoE3 targeted-replacement mouse embryos, 25 DIV
